title: AtomicVLA: Unlocking the Potential of Atomic Skill Learning in Robots
abstract: arXiv:2603.07648v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in Visual-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising potential for robotic manipulation tasks. However, real-world robotic tasks often involve long-horizon, multi-step problem-solving and require generalization for continual skill acquisition, extending beyond single actions or skills. These challenges present significant barriers for existing VLA models, which use monolithic action decoders trained on aggregated data, resulting in poor scalability. To address these challenges, we propose AtomicVLA, a unified planning-and-execution framework that jointly generates task-level plans, atomic skill abstractions, and fine-grained actions. AtomicVLA constructs a scalable atomic skill library through a Skill-Guided Mixture-of-Experts (SG-MoE), where each expert specializes in mastering generic yet precise atomic skills. translated_title: AtomicVLA：释放机器人原子技能学习的潜力
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的最新进展在机器人操作任务中展现出了可喜的潜力。然而，现实世界的机器人任务通常涉及长时程、多步骤的问题求解，并且需要对持续技能获取进行泛化，这超出了单一动作或技能的范畴。这些挑战对现有VLA模型构成了重大障碍，这些模型使用在聚合数据上训练的整体式动作解码器，导致可扩展性较差。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了AtomicVLA，这是一个统一的规划与执行框架，能够联合生成任务级规划、原子技能抽象和细粒度动作。AtomicVLA通过技能引导的专家混合构建了一个可扩展的原子技能库，其中每个专家专门掌握通用而精确的原子技能。此外，我们还引入了一个灵活的路由编码器，能够自动分配专用的原子……（摘要内容不完整，在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出AtomicVLA统一规划与执行框架，通过技能引导的专家混合构建可扩展的原子技能库，联合生成任务级规划、原子技能抽象和细粒度动作，提升了VLA模型在长时程多步骤机器人操作任务中的泛化能力和可扩展性。
en_tdlr: AtomicVLA is a unified planning-and-execution framework that builds a scalable atomic skill library via Skill-Guided Mixture-of-Experts (SG-MoE), jointly generating task-level plans, atomic skill abstractions, and fine-grained actions to improve generalization and scalability of VLA models in long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks.
